evidence.passage: Audit of PROTOCOL.md Section 6.1 reveals 720 runs by pooling 24 dev and 24 held-out cases across 3 replications. To avoid unapproved expansion and maintain pre-registration isolation, the held-out denominator is corrected to 24 cases, with minimum recommended pilot 24x5x1=120 and held-out 24x5x1=120 runs.

Audit of EVALUATION_SPEC.md Section 6.2 reveals unjustified double-blind designation; agents observe condition prompts, so blinding applies strictly to assessors and automated scoring scripts (single-blind / masked assessor evaluation). Furthermore, repeated trials on the same case are clustered, not independent units; case-level paired exact McNemar tests and Wilson intervals must be applied.

Audit of primary literature reveals: (1) Adaptive-RAG (Jeong et al., NAACL 2024) implements an iterative multi-step retrieval branch where subsequent retrieval hops adapt to prior queries; claiming it cannot adapt overstates absence. (2) Reflexion (Shinn et al., NeurIPS 2023) maintains trajectory-based linguistic self-reflection; claiming it is strictly a scalar oracle overstates absence. (3) STORM (Shao et al., NAACL 2024) executes multi-turn conversational dialogue with search trajectories; claiming it is static without trajectory overstates absence.
